Compliant. Every named risk (a to f) checks out. I found no wrong mapping, missed test, missing CHANGELOG note or contradictory test. I read the whole diff (33 KB) in passes.

### Strengths
- The change is narrow. It touches only the deny-list values and leaves Stop and ToolCalls alone.
- Anthropic, Bedrock and Gemini each have a test for the new values. Gemini uses one table test that covers both the changed values and the kept `Other` values (LANGUAGE, OTHER, MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL, PUP_LIMITED_DISABLED).
- Bedrock gets an added test (`malformed_stop_reasons_stay_other`) that pins the decision to keep these values in `Other`.
- The spec table in §10.1 has a source tag on every row. It also records doubtful keep decisions (LANGUAGE, PUP_LIMITED_DISABLED) and the one source gap ([OC]: the OpenAI Chat web reference was not read).
- The new Anthropic test carries an honest HAND-AUTHORED header.

- **(a) Stop, ToolCalls, `function_call` unchanged: pass.** The OpenAI Chat `function_call` mapping is not in the diff. LiteLLM keeps `"tool_calls" | "function_call" => ToolCalls`. The Gemini and Bedrock Stop and ToolCalls arms are untouched.
- **(b) Tests and stale expectations: pass.**
  - Every changed value has a test: Anthropic `stream.rs:1416`, Bedrock `stream.rs:822`, Gemini `stream.rs:~262-300` and LiteLLM `stream.rs:1016`.
  - The old Bedrock `Other("model_context_window_exceeded")` expectation was rewritten.
  - A grep of `crates`, `tests` and `docs/book` finds no remaining test that expects `Other` for any changed value.
- **(c) CHANGELOG `### Upgrade notes` under `## [Unreleased]`: pass for Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini and LiteLLM.** The Gemini note has five bullets, one per changed value.
- **(d) LiteLLM fixture: pass.**
  - `some_future_reason` still exercises the `Other` fallback in the unit test (`stream.rs:~1030`) and in `tests/streaming.rs:~162`.
  - The header says HAND-AUTHORED and records the SMA-864 value change.
  - The grep finds no other user of `guardrail_intervened`.
  - The `conformance.rs` doc comment was updated to match.
- **(e) Gemini CONTINUATION: pass.** I fetched the Gemini API reference (aistudio.google.com/api-reference/generate-content). It says "Token generation was stopped because the response reached the per-request token limit, but generation is not yet complete." That is a cut by a limit, so `Length` is correct. The same page confirms these descriptions:
  - IMAGE_SAFETY: "generated images contain safety violations"
  - ESCALATION: "Request was filtered by an escalation rule"
  - LANGUAGE: "flagged for using an unsupported language" (kept as `Other`, which is defensible)

  I did not read the last 3 KB of that page, so the enum list is not fully checked.
- **(f) Spec §10.1 table: pass.** It covers all six translators (Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini, OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, LiteLLM), and each row names a source.

### Issues
#### Critical (Must Fix)
None.

#### Important (Should Fix)
None.

#### Minor (Nice to Have)
- The spec table for OpenAI Chat leans on the `async-openai` enum [OC] and not the OpenAI web reference, and the table says so. The effect is small: those values did not change.
- The Anthropic and LiteLLM CHANGELOG bullets say "now fails with `ToolCallsNotRun`" for a turn that holds tool calls. That wording relies on the core change in the same release. This is fine if both ship together.

### Assessment
**Task quality:** Approved
**Reasoning:** All six checks pass. The Gemini CONTINUATION mapping to `Length` matches the vendor description I fetched, and every changed mapping has a test and a CHANGELOG note.
